articles.summary: Awards celebrate partners who delivered measurable results and advanced AI-elevated customer experiences worldwideSAN RAMON, Calif. — Five9 (Nasdaq: FIVN), provider of the Intelligent CX Platform, today announced the winners of its 2025 Global Partner Awards. The awards recognize partners who delivered exceptional performance, innovation, and measurable customer outcomes across the Five9 ecosystem in 2025.
articles.title: Five9 Honors Global Partner Award Winners, Recognizing Excellence in CX Innovation, Performance, and Customer Impact
